failure_type: wind / gusts + late detection (short sensing range) + UAV too fast to react
explanation: The flight failed due to a combination of high cruise speed and a tailwind of 5.7 m/s, which prevented the UAV from reacting in time to a late-detected obstacle. Counterfactual analysis confirms that reducing the UAV speed by 30%, increasing sensing range to 25 m, or removing the wind would have prevented the failure.
